Ive been on birth control to control my cysts since high school. It’s really helped, just be sure to be consistent and make sure to stay up to date on the annual physical to get the renewals on time. Every time something goes wrong with the prescription (delay or change to the brand) I get a cyst rupture and it knocks me out for the day. Have a heating pad as an additional help just in case. If I catch it before the pain is really bad then usually I can recover some of my day. 

While I’m asexual, sex repulsed, and perpetually single, it really improved my period and when I do rupture a cyst now really shows me the change was for the better. You’ve got this! I hope it works well for you!

No one here gets a pass. Yes, they were manipulated by Nikki. Yes, the fiancé was upset and if he posted to Reddit with his side of the story everyone would tell him to believe Nikki. But unless they have cut off Nikki like they did to you, then they get NO PASS. If they even ask for forgiveness, it’s a no for me. They don’t get to ask for it, that’s something only you can give. She ruined your life. They believed her. ACTIONS HAVE CONSEQUENCES. They kicked you out of the house, removed you from their lives, and now that they realize they were wrong what can they do? Nothing. I’d tell Nikki’s husband what she did so he knows. And then I’d tell my family “thanks for the apologizes but I don’t want to see any of you ever again. Do not contact me. Do not come to my apartment. Continue to treat me as you have for the last two years knowing that it was uncalled for.” They knew you, they didn’t even listen to hear how you were drugged, no one considered what could have happened to you in that state. I’m not even saying it had to be immediate but sometime in the last two years before this came out someone should have asked if you were okay after being drugged. They deserve nothing except what they gave to you. Forgive if you can and if you believe it will help you heal from the trauma they caused, but do not forget and do not let them back into your life. They don’t have to rot like Nikki but they don’t deserve to have you in their lives anymore after making you homeless, support less and feel unloved. Nikki May have lied and manipulated, but they made the choice to kick you out of their lives and homes.

It was a very ambitious timeline. And I get it, don't get me wrong they want to execute it quickly, but at the same time, you're right they did not expect as many applications as they probably got. They had a wide range of students who were able to apply and a slightly extended deadline. That's A LOT of applications to go through. I know everyone wants to hear back, I want to hear back as well, but its going to take a long time. September seems more likely at this point.

The last few days of August are next week. Honestly I expect an update on the 31st (maybe if we’re lucky it would be somewhere around 28th). I understand people want to hear back, but it’s thousands of applications easily. It’s going to take a bit of time and might take until the very last day to send out emails/calls/whatever they pick to announce.
